question: What status does one attain after reciting in relation to the beloved woman?
premises: Recitation involving the beloved woman is performed.
This act follows the prior teaching.
A lordship over all successes is named as result.
inference: After such recitation one becomes lord of all successes.
uncertainties: The exact ritual sense of reciting the beloved woman is not fully explicit.
plain_english: Then indeed, having recited the beloved woman, one becomes the lord of all successes.
